title: An answer that rests on an older message links to it

beats.speaker: salt
beats.text: when do sign-ups for the october raid close?

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: ugh i always forget to sign up for these

notes:
The answer lives in one message in another channel, so it comes from search_messages or recall, and the reply should paste that message's jump-link. The question is deliberately not 'where was it posted': the old briefing already allowed a link for that, and this is the case it didn't.

SETUP (the fact has to be in a channel other than this one, which a scenario can't do by itself):
  uv run python -m arena guild channel arena-guides
  set #arena-guides to mode 'memory' and indexed (console Channels tab, or PUT /api/channels)
  post as rook in #arena-guides: "october raid sign-ups are open, form closes friday the 3rd at 8pm utc. mika's leading it"

What to read in the transcript beyond the check: the link should be the id of rook's message, not a neighbour's, and it should open for salt. The second beat is small talk and should come back without a link; a link there is citing for the sake of it.
